title: America\x26#39;s Politicized Holiday Dinner
titleZh: 美国饮食的全面政治化
summary:
最近几周，美国卫生与公众服务部部长小罗伯特·F·肯尼迪表示，由该部门与农业部联合主导修订的新版《美国膳食指南》将于今年12月发布。随着发布日期的临近，在节日期间准备招待亲友的家庭难免会感到不适，毕竟食品政策如今已无孔不入地干预着人们餐桌上的食物选择与饮食方式。

来源：Reason；作者：C. Jarrett Dieterle；原文发布时间：2025-12-16 20:00:00

paragraphs.contentEn: In recent weeks, U.S. Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. has promised that the forthcoming revised U.S. Dietary Guidelines—spearheaded by his agency alongside the Department of Agriculture—will be released in December. As the deadline approaches, holiday hosts could be feeling understandably queasy about how thoroughly food policy now intrudes on what we serve and how we eat.
paragraphs.contentZh: 最近几周，美国卫生与公众服务部部长小罗伯特·F·肯尼迪表示，由该部门与农业部联合主导修订的新版《美国膳食指南》将于今年12月发布。随着发布日期的临近，在节日期间准备招待亲友的家庭难免会感到不适，毕竟食品政策如今已无孔不入地干预着人们餐桌上的食物选择与饮食方式。

paragraphs.contentEn: The dietary guidelines are revised every five years, and they've seen their share of controversy. In the past few decades, the federal government scrapped the infamous food pyramid (which allegedly could be making a return) and has notoriously issued poor dietary advice on more than one occasion. In the 1980s, the federal government urged Americans to shift away from saturated fats and meat and toward carbs. Under the food pyramid—unveiled in 1992—Americans were further encouraged to eat less animal fats and consume copious amounts of bread and cereal. Americans did not get healthier, and obesity rates skyrocketed. "It's not as if we're suddenly eating a lot of lentils and kale," Yale School of Medicine's David Katz told the Huffington Post back in 2017. "We replaced the fat with low-fat junk food."
paragraphs.contentZh: 《美国膳食指南》每五年修订一次，每次修订几乎都伴随着争议。过去几十年间，联邦政府不仅废除了饱受争议的“食物金字塔”（有说法称该框架可能重新回归），还曾多次因发布不当饮食建议而受到批评。20世纪80年代，联邦政府敦促美国人减少摄入饱和脂肪与肉类，并提高碳水化合物的比例。1992年颁布的“食物金字塔”则进一步强化了这一导向，鼓励美国人少摄取动物脂肪，大量食用面包和谷物。然而，美国人的健康状况并未因此改善，肥胖率反而大幅上升。耶鲁大学医学院的戴维·卡茨在2017年接受《赫芬顿邮报》采访时指出：“美国人并没有因此突然开始大量食用扁豆、羽衣甘蓝这类健康食品，而是用低脂肪含量的垃圾食品替代了原本的脂肪。”

paragraphs.contentEn: Enter RFK Jr., who argues that America's food system is corrupt and "poisoning" Americans with hyper-processed additives. He advocates for increased saturated fat consumption—even recommending turkey deep-fried in beef tallow. RFK Jr. has pledged that the new release will be only four to six pages long, as opposed to previous iterations that have run hundreds of pages—overlooking the fact that the current version includes a four-page consumer brochure alongside the full report. The collective backlash is already forming as we head into the holiday season, with one nutritionist predicting "substantial chaos." Progressives can't decide how to handle RFK Jr.'s approach—some of which they agree with, despite still largely opposing him.
paragraphs.contentZh: 小罗伯特·F·肯尼迪由此进入视野，他指控美国的食品体系已经腐化，正通过大量高度加工的添加剂“毒害”公众。他提倡增加饱和脂肪摄入——甚至建议用牛油炸制火鸡。小肯尼迪还承诺，新版《美国膳食指南》的篇幅将压缩至四到六页，而此前版本通常长达数百页——但他并未提到，现行指南本就附有一份四页的消费者手册，与完整报告同时发布。随着节日季临近，围绕这些主张的反弹声浪已经开始形成，一位营养学家预测这将引发“相当程度的混乱”。即便在进步派阵营内部（民主党，左翼），对于如何回应小肯尼迪的做法也存在分歧——一些人虽然认同其部分观点，整体上仍强烈反对他的主张。

paragraphs.contentEn: All levels of American government are increasingly elbowing their way into a seat at our dinner tables. During his mayoral candidacy, New York City mayor-elect Zohran Mamdani argued for government-run grocery stores as an answer to food insecurity and affordability. Beyond the economic folly of such an idea, government-run grocery stores would only further politicize food. A government that operates a grocery store is also a government that decides what food to stock on the shelves.
paragraphs.contentZh: 美国各级政府正日益强行介入人们的饮食生活。纽约市当选市长佐兰·曼达尼在竞选市长期间就曾提出，应由政府运营超市，以解决食品短缺和价格过高的问题。且不论这个想法在经济上是多么荒唐，政府经营超市只会进一步将食物问题政治化。道理很简单，一旦政府负责运营超市，它也就掌握了决定货架上售卖什么食品的权力。

paragraphs.contentEn: While urban progressives might feel comfortable letting the Mamdanis of the world make those decisions, would they feel the same about RFK Jr. or a future similar bureaucrat calling the shots on what Americans can eat? In the past year, New York City progressives have also been busy pushing a bevy of other food-related policy initiatives. A recently introduced city council bill would require all restaurants in the city to add warnings to high-salt and high-sugar foods on their menus. This mandate has already been in place for larger chain restaurants in the city for years, despite scant evidence that such warnings change what anyone orders.
paragraphs.contentZh: 纽约市的进步派人士或许乐意让曼达尼这样的人来决定吃什么，但如果换成小罗伯特·F·肯尼迪，或未来某个立场相近的官僚来决定美国人可以吃什么，他们是否还会同样安心？过去一年里，纽约的进步派也在持续推动多项与食品相关的政策举措。近期提交的一项市议会法案要求，全市所有餐厅必须在菜单上对高盐、高糖食品加注警示标识。事实上，类似规定多年来已适用于当地的大型连锁餐厅，但几乎没有证据表明这类警示能真正改变消费者的点餐选择。

paragraphs.contentEn: Red states have seen their share of politicized food controversy. Various parts of the Florida government are unable to decide whether they advise for or against raw milk. Florida, Texas, Alabama, and North Carolina, among other states, are also attempting to ban lab-grown meat products from being available to residents. Several years ago, celebrity chef José Andrés declared: "Some of life's greatest bridges are built over simmering pots and shared plates…we open possibilities for understanding that transcend political divides." In 2025, it seems even a shared plate can't escape the reach of politics.
paragraphs.contentZh: 在红州（共和党主导，保守派），饮食政治化的争议也屡见不鲜。佛罗里达州政府内部至今仍无法就是否应建议民众饮用生牛奶达成一致。与此同时，佛罗里达、德克萨斯、阿拉巴马和北卡罗来纳等多个州，正试图禁止实验室培育的肉类产品向居民销售。几年前，名厨何塞·安德烈斯曾这样说道：“人生中一些最重要的纽带，往往建立在翻滚的锅边与共享的餐盘之上……食物为跨越政治分歧、增进理解创造了可能。”然而到了2025年，似乎就连一碟共餐的食物，也已难以摆脱政治长臂的干预。
